structural_development.rationale: POST substantially elaborates every content category with named sub-genres, specific geographic anchors (China, Thai-English-Chinese), and topical detail (culture, travel, daily life, vlogs, behind-the-scenes, challenges). The four categories each receive multi-clause specification, and percentages are added. Overall scope and depth are meaningfully larger than the brief PRE list.

uncertainty.coder_notes: The meme and review events are clean Elaborated cases. The language-learning and 'random'-to-Personal-Experimental events sit close to the Elaborated/Reframed boundary; Reframed was selected because in both cases the organizing frame shifted (linguistic → cultural-bilingual; unplanned → deliberate). The 'random → Personal & Experimental Content' lineage required the new/removed re-check and was converted from an initial Removed+New framing into a Reframed matched pair.
